bundleUploadedAt.description: UPLOAD mode: when the served bundle was last deployed. Set by the server whenever content is sent, and not settable directly; null means nothing has been deployed yet, so the component has nothing to serve. UTC.

content.description: UPLOAD mode: the built file to serve, as text. Send it to deploy or replace the bundle; omit it to leave the current one untouched. Never returned — read the component's remoteURL to fetch it.

additionalProperties.description: Additional contextual attributes for component configuration

entryFile.description: Path within the repo to the component's entry file (git mode).

iconURL.description: URL of the icon to be displayed in the UI

id.description: Unique identifier for the web component

name.description: Unique identifier for the web component

remoteURL.description: Hosted location of the component script. In URL mode this is supplied directly; in git mode it is computed by the backend from the checked-out repo and returned read-only.

sourceMode.description: URL (you host it), GIT (we clone a repo) or UPLOAD (you send the built file as content). Inferred from the fields set when omitted.

tooltip.description: Tooltip text to display on hover

type.description: Which UI surface renders the component — this is the component's scope. NAV_APP is the navigation sidebar, BLUEPRINT the project overview, ENVIRONMENT the environment pages. RESOURCE is reserved and rejected; TAB_APP is deprecated, renders nowhere and is rejected on write.

blueprintName.description: Project (blueprint) name. Null means every project. Required to be present as a deliberate choice in the UI, not left blank.

environmentId.description: Environment (cluster) id — the match key. Null means every environment of blueprintName. Requires blueprintName to be set.

environmentName.description: Environment name, stored for display only and never matched on. May be stale after a rename.

resourceName.description: Reserved for resource scope, which is not yet supported.
